mainEntity.name: Is there a Hostinger coupon code?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Black Friday page we read lists the offer as automatic and shows no code. Check Hostinger's page on the day you buy.

mainEntity.name: When does the Hostinger Black Friday offer end?

acceptedAnswer.text: The page we read says 14 December 2026. It started on 19 October.

mainEntity.name: How much is Hostinger with the Black Friday offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Premium is $1.99 a month on a 48-month term, with $95.52 due today. Unlimited is $2.79 and Cloud Startup is $7.99.

mainEntity.name: What does Hostinger cost after the offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Premium renews at $10.99 a month, Unlimited at $16.99 and Cloud Startup at $25.99.

mainEntity.name: Does a Hostinger coupon work with the sale price?

acceptedAnswer.text: We could not confirm that a code stacks with the sale price. Compare the price at checkout.
